name: Cult of the Dragon Initiate

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Learn Draconic, or another language from the PHB or Heroes of Faerûn if you already know Draconic. Language fallback is not automated. Magic action: a visible creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus). Failure: Frightened until your next turn ends. After succeeding or the effect ending, it is immune for 24 hours. When you make a creature Frightened of you, gain Heroic Inspiration if you lack it. Once per Short or Long Rest.
